topic.readerProblem: A marketer or founder searching for an AI search optimization tool, AEO tool or AI SEO platform faces three different product types under one label and needs to know which type to buy, which trade-offs matter and which red flags to walk away from before paying.
topic.connection: AEOeye sells an AI visibility measurement tool (free audit, $29 one-time report). The page explains how to choose any tool in the category, shows AEOeye's own audit records and crawler study with their caveats, states AEOeye's limits (snapshot, no daily tracking, no content writing) and points to dedicated trackers where they fit better.

assessment: The page now answers the buying question on the first screen (pick the type by the question it answers; only AI visibility measurement shows whether engines name your brand), then backs five trade-offs with primary research and vendor documentation (prompt-wording sensitivity, run-to-run variance, model drift, model pinning), AEOeye's own benchmark and crawler-study numbers with their caveats, a walk-away list, a scorecard and a pre-purchase test. It deliberately does not claim hands-on testing of any vendor, quality verdicts on vendors, per-engine comparisons from AEOeye's small self-selected audit sample, or tracking features AEOeye does not have.

sources.supports: Defines generative engine optimization, also known as answer engine optimization, as the practice of improving visibility in responses generated by generative AI systems.
Ahrefs presents Brand Radar as part of its platform, tracking brand visibility across AI answers (AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, AI Mode), YouTube and Reddit.
Semrush lists its AI Visibility Toolkit base plan at $99/mo per domain, billed annually, including tracking of 25 custom prompts.
Surfer's homepage titles it an AI Visibility Platform and lists AI search visibility monitoring next to its content optimization tools.
Jasper's homepage offers a GEO Diagnostic that shows what AI says about a brand, alongside its marketing content agents.
Google states there are no additional requirements or special optimizations to appear in AI Overviews or AI Mode and that no special schema.org markup is needed.
GEO paper (Aggarwal et al., KDD 2024): a framework for content creators; GEO can boost visibility by up to 40% in generative engine responses, and the efficacy of strategies varies across domains.
Sclar et al. (ICLR 2024): subtle prompt-formatting changes produced performance differences of up to 76 accuracy points for LLaMA-2-13B in few-shot settings.
OpenAI's docs say model-generated content is non-deterministic and list pinning production applications to specific model snapshots to ensure consistent behavior.
Anthropic says each Claude model ID is a pinned version that stays constant for the ID's lifetime, though serving-infrastructure changes can occasionally produce minor behavior differences.

SparkToro and Gumshoe.ai: 600 volunteers ran 12 prompts 2,961 times (Nov-Dec 2025); under 1 in 100 chance of the same brand list in two responses; visibility percentage across many runs called a reasonable metric, ranking position not.
Chen, Zaharia and Zou: GPT-4's accuracy at identifying prime numbers fell from 84% (March 2023) to 51% (June 2023); the behavior of the same LLM service can change substantially in a short time.
Defines structured data as a standardized format for describing a page and says Google recommends JSON-LD where the site's setup allows it.
